title: The way in
goals: Do it in fewer than 9 lines.
starting_code:
# An inner gate listens for a word.
# Two doors are sealed by runes.
hints: Take one step up and use `say` for the password to open the inner gate.
Take two steps up, then three steps left, and use `cast` to open the first door.
Walk four steps left and use `cast` again, then go up to the road.
intro: There is an inner gate just ahead. It listens to the same word as the great gate. After that, the passage turns past two sealed doors up to the castle road.
outro: We made it! The castle road is just ahead, and you are ready for school.
